visual.description: Dark bg (#1A1824). A list of 'hard problems' appears in muted text (rgba(232,224,212,0.6)): 'Inequality', 'Inflation', 'Housing' — each with a small 'years + policy + trade-offs' label. Then all three dim further and a single line punches in center in #D47FA6 accent, large: 'Sleep deprivation has a fix. The fix is free.' Hold for emphasis.

notes: Emotional pivot — the script shifts from problem to solution. The 'fix is free' line is the thesis of the Close.
